description: FR-HR-003 -- a category of leave and the rules attached to it.

fields.label: Paid Leave
fields.description: Whether days taken are paid. Unpaid leave still consumes a balance but is treated differently by payroll, which is not built.

fields.label: Carry Forward
fields.description: Whether an unused balance may be carried into the next leave period.

fields.label: Allow Negative Balance
fields.description: Whether an application may exceed the balance. Off by default, so an over-application is refused rather than silently allowed.

fields.label: Count Holidays As Leave
fields.description: When set, holidays falling inside a leave period are counted as leave days. When clear they are skipped.

fields.label: Maximum Leaves Per Period
fields.description: An upper bound on what may be allocated in one leave period. Zero means no limit is enforced.

name: KNIT 360 Leave Type
